explanation: The top-level corpus contains eight demand records, all with demand_score >= 3, so n06-r01 qualifies and should have been retained. The downstream job received only seven needs/evidence_sources, missing n06-r01. The visible upstream normalize function is responsible because its allowed_record_ids list excludes n06-r01 and includes n06-r09 instead, causing the stipulated qualifying record to be silently omitted before the handoff. Job 2 appears to preserve and rank the records it actually received.
